name: PAN card (new application)
mode_reason: The application, e-KYC with Aadhaar, fee payment and e-PAN download are all online; no centre visit is required.
documents: Aadhaar card (used for e-KYC and as identity proof)
A recent passport-size photograph (digital upload)
A scanned signature (digital upload)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
An active email address
steps: Open the official PAN application portal and choose New PAN for an Indian citizen (Form 49A) with e-KYC and e-sign.
Fill the form with your name exactly as printed on your Aadhaar, plus date of birth and contact details.
Verify with the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Upload your photograph and signature in the sizes the portal asks for.
Pay the application fee shown at checkout on the official portal.
Note the acknowledgement number, track the status, and download the e-PAN PDF once issued.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Aadhaar (update address or demographic details)
mode_reason: Address and demographic updates can be requested online on the myAadhaar portal with document upload; no centre visit is needed for an online update.
documents: Your Aadhaar number (12 digits) or Enrolment ID
The mobile number registered with Aadhaar, to receive the OTP
One valid proof of address (recent electricity or water bill, bank passbook, rent agreement, passport, or another document from the UIDAI list)
For a name or date-of-birth change, the supporting proof listed on the portal
steps: Open myAadhaar and log in with your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile.
Choose Update Aadhaar Online and select the field you want to change (address, name, date of birth and so on).
Enter the new details exactly as they appear on your proof document.
Upload a clear scan of the proof document in the accepted format and size.
Submit and note the Update Request Number (URN) shown on the screen.
Track the request online. If it is rejected or needs biometric confirmation, visit an Aadhaar centre.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Voter ID (new registration, Form 6)
mode_reason: Form 6 is filled and submitted online with document uploads, but a Booth Level Officer may visit or call for verification before your name is added to the roll.
documents: One proof of age (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, Class 10 marksheet, or passport)
One proof of current address (electricity bill, water bill, rent agreement, bank passbook, or passport)
A recent passport-size photograph (digital upload)
steps: Create an account on the Voters' Service Portal with your mobile number.
Fill Form 6 online with your details and current constituency.
Upload your age proof, address proof and photograph.
Submit and save the acknowledgement number you receive.
Track the application online and respond if the Booth Level Officer contacts you for verification.
Once approved, download the e-EPIC voter card or collect the physical card.
fee_note: Registration is generally free; see the official portal.

name: Passport (fresh application)
mode_reason: The form and appointment booking are online, but you must appear in person at a Passport Seva Kendra for document verification, photograph and biometrics.
documents: Proof of address (Aadhaar card, electricity bill, bank passbook, rent agreement, or another document from the portal's list)
Proof of date of birth (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, or another document from the portal's list)
Aadhaar card
Old passport or citizenship documents, if applicable
steps: Register on the Passport Seva portal and log in.
Fill the online application form carefully, matching your documents exactly.
Pay the fee shown on the portal and book an appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office PSK.
Save or print the appointment receipt (ARN) and application receipt.
Visit the Passport Seva Kendra on your appointment day with original documents and photocopies.
Track the application online; police verification is usually scheduled after your visit.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Learner's Licence
mode_reason: Application, fee payment and in many states the test can be completed online through Parivahan, but a visit to the RTO is needed for document verification and biometrics before the licence is issued.
documents: Proof of age (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, passport, or similar)
Proof of address (Aadhaar card, electricity bill, rent agreement, or similar)
Passport-size photographs
Aadhaar number, for e-KYC where your state supports it
Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness (Form 1A medical certificate where required)
steps: Open the Parivahan Sarathi portal and choose Apply for Learner Licence.
Complete e-KYC with your Aadhaar where supported, or apply with document upload.
Fill the application, upload documents and photographs, and pay the fee shown on the portal.
Book the learner's test slot; in many states the test can be taken online from home.
Pass the test on road signs and traffic rules.
Visit the RTO as instructed for document verification and biometrics, then download or collect your licence.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.
